Generic translated halving equations for F(X)=sum F_i X^i and P=(0,y0):
  k = +/- y0
  a = (F4 - m^2)/(2*F5)
  b = (F3 - 2*m*n - F5*a^2)/(2*F5)
  K2 = F2 - n^2 - 2*m*k - 2*F5*a*b = 0
  K1 = F1 - 2*n*k - F5*b^2 = 0
